name: emotion_context_eval_v1_lite
description: Held-out controlled text stimuli for ASNE v1-lite dictionary evaluation. Labels are expected stimulus-response categories only.

items.text: A person unlocks a meeting room, places markers near the board, and turns on the lights.
Someone carries two library books across the courtyard and drops them into the return slot.
A person wipes a counter, stacks several trays, and checks that the back door is closed.
A person stops when the basement light cuts out and a heavy object falls nearby.
Someone sees a figure waiting beside their car after the parking lot has emptied.
A person hears the front lock scrape while they are alone in the apartment.
A person takes one framed photo from the wall and wraps it before leaving the room.
Someone reads the last page of a letter and sits quietly while the kettle cools.
A person returns a borrowed key and walks home past a window that is no longer lit.
A person studies a receipt with three totals and cannot match any of them to the order.
Someone reaches a hallway intersection where every sign points toward the same room.
A person opens a package of parts and finds labels that do not match the instructions.
A person finds the dropped ring under the sofa after searching each room twice.
Someone sees the delayed bus turn the corner just before the last connection leaves.
A person checks the file again and sees that the missing page was saved after all.
